Setting.Name: TESSERA::API::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enables the staged TESSERA external API. Keep disabled until API identities, keys, groups, SupportAssignments, and ContractEntitlements are configured.

Setting.Name: GenericInterface::Operation::Module###TESSERA::Stage

Setting.Description: Registers the caller-owned TESSERA staging status operation.
